_: WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The trust gate (docs/trust-gate.md) switches OFF every record mechanic Wanderer's Guide does not encode, so the app ships only what the WG parity effort has verified. That rule is right for the 11,100 records nobody has read against print, and WRONG for the ~150 records the owner personally ruled on at the rulings desk on 2026-09-10: those he HAS read, and a ruling that builds or keeps a mechanic would ship dark the day it lands unless this file says otherwise. So every desk number in work/owner-questions.json is given exactly one disposition here, and the generator (scripts/trust-ledger.mjs) removes an `approvals` entry's field paths from that record's OFF list. Hand-maintained on purpose: an approval is a judgement about which FIELDS a ruling turns on, and that cannot be read out of prose (docs/trust-gate.md:361-363).
_dispositions: approvals = the ruling KEEPS or ADDS a mechanic WG does not encode on that record, so the named paths must stay ON. noMechanic = the ruling changes nothing a field carries (it settles a difference, removes a duplicate control, fixes prose or a value), or the mechanic it lands on is a kind WG already encodes on that record so the gate leaves it alone. engine = the ruling is code, not a record field. unruled = the 22 numbers work/desk-answers-2026-09-10.json skips (already ruled, deferred, or a standing authorised exception); they carry no approval until the owner answers them.
_fieldPaths: ⚠ scripts/data/trust-fields.json (the strippable universe, plan §2a) DID NOT EXIST when this file was written — lane A had not produced it. Every path below is therefore taken from the OUR_KINDS field lists at scripts/wg-diff.mjs:396-582 and the nested container paths ourKindsOf walks at scripts/wg-diff.mjs:1216-1330 (`choice.options[].grant.*`, `effectChoices[].options[].grant.*`, `whileActive[].*`, `enhancement.grant.*`, `resonant.*`, `passiveEffects.*`). When trust-fields.json lands, re-check every path here against it.
_pending: "pending": true means the RECORD does not exist in public/core.json yet — the ruling creates it, and `record` is the intended id. A field named in `fields` that the record does not carry yet is normal and expected: the approval is written BEFORE the desk fix so the fix is live the moment it lands (docs/trust-gate.md:327-329).
_multipleRows: A desk number may own MORE THAN ONE approvals row when one ruling touches several records (the quah emblem family, the six kitsune/nagaji feats, the magus/summoner move). What must be unique is the DISPOSITION: no number appears in two of the four lists. test/trust-approvals.test.ts pins exactly that.
